title: launch-sprint-pocket-brain-dump
content:
Purpose: quick pocket notes for my prep before the weekly launch-sprint sync. Not polished — meant to be a fast checklist and catch-all for follow-ups after meeting.

Context / where we are:
- Current train: 2026-03-sprint-3 (target push 2026-03-18).
- Main risk areas flagged last week: Dedicated pool scaling, canary rollback hook, telemetry retention for post-launch diagnostics.
- Owners mostly assigned but some partial handoffs; I need to confirm handoff for infra rollback and console alerts.

On my agenda (10 min prep):
- Quick scoreboard: green/amber/red for each lane (infra, runtime, console, QA, docs, comms).
- Confirm canary plan: who runs manual validation (Sofia) vs automated smoke (CI).
- Check capacity numbers for Dedicated burst policy (Diego to confirm GPU headroom).
- Re-iterate fallback routing policy and ensure a playbook link in chat ops.
- Ask for explicit cutover window + owner for final rollout.

Go/No-Go quick checklist (one-liners for the sync) — if anything is RED, call a follow-up immediately:
- Infra provisioning: reserved capacity confirmed for weekend (owner: Diego) — STATUS: amber (waiting confirm by 03/12).
- Serving runtime: perf smoke passed at 90% of expected QPS (owner: Noah) — STATUS: green but latency p99 spike seen in seq-len=2048 tests.
- Canary job: smoke + user-sim (owner: Sofia) — STATUS: amber (smoke green, user-sim flaky).
- Rollback automation: k8s job & fallback routing tested (owner: Maya) — STATUS: red (missing alert trigger).
- Observability: trace retention + cost tags present (owner: observability eng) — STATUS: amber (partial).
- Docs & runbook: final runbook link in playbook and page updated (owner: docs) — STATUS: green (draft in PR).
- CS comms: customer advisory drafted for customers on Dedicated (owner: CS lead) — STATUS: green (needs approval).

Immediate talking points for the sync:
- Call out rollback alert gap: action needed now or we hold on go/no-go for weekend.
- Ask Diego for hard number on GPU headroom and expected scaling latency if burst enabled.
- Flag p99 latency anomaly on long-sequence tests and ask for mitigation plan (quantization/sequence-splitting).
- Confirm canary acceptance criteria (explicit success metrics) and who signs off.

Quick risks & mitigation brainstorm (to propose):
- Risk: Canary flaky due to synthetic user-sim timing windows. Mitigation: expand user-sim window + add two independent smoke validators.
- Risk: Rollback alert missing => manual rollback latency 15-30 min. Mitigation: add a simple PagerDuty alert tied to rollback job failure and a one-button rollback script in SRE's private-runbook.
- Risk: Observability spikes cost during canary > budget. Mitigation: reduce trace sampling for canary; enable sampling ratio toggle in runtime.

Open questions I need answers to (quick hits):
- Diego: can you confirm "burst headroom" count and whether autoscaler will pre-warm GPUs? (due 03/12)
- Noah: what produced the p99 spike — model variant, kernel, or scheduling? any temporary mitigation? (due 03/12)
- Sofia: which metric indicates canary success? error rate threshold + latency window? please paste exact query we can run in meeting. (due 03/11)
- Docs: has the runbook been linked into the console rollout page? provide link. (due 03/12)

Personal run-of-show notes (what I'll say / prompts):
- "We only greenlight the weekend if rollback alert + one-button rollback are in place — else we delay."
- "If p99 latency remains unexplained, we can still canary but keep traffic at 10% and extend monitoring window to 48h."
- "Diego — give me the headroom numbers now and commit to an on-call to watch autoscaler during push."

After-sync action items (my personal todo):
- If rollback alert remains missing: create RFC ticket with minimal alert payload + assign to SRE and me; set PD escalation (due 03/11).
- Pull the canary success query from Sofia and run it against staging for the last 24h; paste results to #launch-ops (due 03/11).
- Draft the short customer-facing advisory and ping CS lead for 1-hr review (due 03/13).
- Add runbook link to the console rollout page and confirm doc owner updated (due 03/12).
- Schedule a 20-min follow-up with Noah to deep-dive p99 (if still amber) (tentative 03/12 16:00).

Notes-to-self (loose thoughts / shorthand):
- Might need to swap canary validator if Sofia is overloaded — have backup: "perf-qa-team" small list.
- Keep traffic on canary low if any amber— prefer conservative launch.
- Remind legal to pre-approve launch advisory wording if any customer-impact risk flagged.

Slack snippets to copy/paste in meeting and chat:
- Meeting: "Quick sync: we can go if rollback alert + GPU headroom confirmed. Otherwise hold."
- #launch-ops: "Rolling status: infra amber (waiting headroom), runtime green w/ p99 anomaly. Action items: Diego to confirm headroom, Noah to triage p99, Sofia to surface canary query."

End-of-day checklist (will tick in personal notes):
- [ ] Confirm rollback alert PR merged or ticket created
- [ ] Verify canary query results in #launch-ops
- [ ] Runbook link present in console page
- [ ] Customer advisory drafted and sent for review
- [ ] Follow-up meeting scheduled if p99 unresolved

Random reminders:
- Keep meeting tight — this is prep only, don't dive into debugging in the sync; assign and follow-up outside.
- Capture any new risks as a short bullet and tag owner immediately.

References & quick links (paste after meeting):
- Runbook (draft): CONFLUENCE:RT-Launch-Runbook
- Canary PR: GITHUB:github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/982
- Jira epic: JIRA:RL-2026

-- end pocket dump --

(Will clean up later and transfer completed items to the proper release tracking doc once green.)
